title: Nonnegativity of influence
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $i\in[n]$, and let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb{R}$. The influence of coordinate $i$ on $f$ is nonnegative: $\mathrm{Inf}_i[f]\geq 0$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the Boolean hypercube of dimension $n$
